title: Matrix rain
summary: Digital rain drawn on one canvas: cell-stepped streams, seeded per column, glowing heads.

title: Elapsed clock
summary: An analogue clock sweeping from one time to another with a digital readout and a 'three hours later' caption.

title: Cartoon television
summary: A 1960s cartoon TV that drops in with squash and stretch, static on its screen, and a play button that gets pressed.

title: Bar chart race
summary: Bars that grow and overtake each other between yearly snapshots, with d3 scales and interpolators.

title: Noise field
summary: A drifting field of lines steered by seeded simplex noise, with time as the third noise axis.

title: GSAP title
summary: A title choreographed with a paused GSAP timeline that the film seeks every frame.

title: Lower third
summary: A transparent name strap with in, hold and out, fully driven by controls.

title: Beat pulse
summary: Words cut on bars and a pulse on every beat from the film's tempo, with OKLCH colour blending.

title: Rocket launch
summary: A countdown, ignition with smoke and a camera shake, and a rocket climbing a trajectory that draws itself on.
